outcome: diagnostic accuracy of LUS (sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value, negative predictive value)
cohort: The study included 1531 pregnant patients diagnostically categorized by varied clinical severities of COVID-19 upon hospital admission at a tertiary maternity unit.
finding: Lung ultrasonography (LUS) was found to be a quick, safe, effective, and reproducible diagnostic tool for the screening of COVID-19 pneumonia in pregnant patients.
cross-section timing: Data was collected retrospectively between March 2020 and November 2021, with patient assessments made upon hospital admission.
